commit.message:
feat(deployment): add production deployment setup with Docker, Kubernetes, and monitoring

- Add comprehensive deployment documentation (DEPLOYMENT.md) covering setup, architecture, scaling, security, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
- Introduce production environment example file (.env.prod.example) with necessary environment variables.
- Add production configuration file (deployment/config/production.yaml) with detailed app, server, model, cache, database, security, logging, monitoring, scaling, performance, features, external services, backup, and alert settings.
- Provide Docker Compose production file (deployment/docker-compose.prod.yml) defining services for API, web interface, Redis, PostgreSQL, NGINX, Prometheus, Grafana, and node exporter.
- Add Kubernetes deployment manifests for API deployment, service, autoscaling, and namespace.
- Include NGINX configuration for reverse proxy, rate limiting, security headers, and routing to API and web interface.
- Add deployment script (deployment/scripts/deploy.sh) for automated deployment, rollback, backup, health checks, and cleanup.
- Add run_quality_gates.py for running quality checks on the codebase.
- Add CLI interface (src/protein_diffusion/cli.py) for generation, ranking, folding, and analysis of protein sequences.
- Add monitoring module (src/protein_diffusion/monitoring.py) for system and model metrics collection and logging.
- Add optimization module (src/protein_diffusion/optimization.py) for caching, batch processing, model optimization, and memory management.
- Add scaling module (src/protein_diffusion/scaling.py) for auto-scaling, load balancing, service registry, and circuit breaker.
- Add security module (src/protein_diffusion/security.py) for input sanitization, rate limiting, file validation, and security management.
- Add Streamlit web app (app.py) providing interactive UI for protein generation, ranking, visualization, and settings.
- Add integration and unit tests for end-to-end and diffuser components.

This commit establishes a robust production-ready deployment and operational framework for the Protein Diffusion Design Lab.
